sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: before you drive: tires, seat and mirrors, safety belts, air bags, child passengers, loads and driver assistance
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The manual's child restraint table runs across physical pages 49 and 50; each stage is cited to page 49, where its age or height threshold is printed, and the booster belt requirement is cited to page 50 [A07].
The manual credits the safety belt benefit to studies without naming them, so the dossier repeats the claim as the manual's statement and adds no figures [A05].
The unsecured load paragraph names a misdemeanor, a fine and the cleanup cost but gives no fine amount, so none is stated here [A08].
The child restraint stages are the manual's summary of SC Code §56-5-6410; the statute text itself was not read in this pass and is held as typed debt [A07].

corpus_stability.reason: The South Carolina Driver's Manual prints a single edition line (Revised 06/2024) on its front cover; its disclaimer says legislative and SCDMV policy changes may make some content out of date until the agency incorporates them, and a possibly newer unlinked upload exists on the issuer site (freshness debt in the run jams), so the corpus is treated as revised at most about once a year, bound to the registered snapshot.

verification_debt.claim_text: The child restraint stages on physical pages 49 and 50 summarize SC Code §56-5-6410; the statute text and the Buckle Up, South Carolina page were not read or compared in this pass.
